scope: Own-method component experiments after source/support correction. No external baseline, temporal BGK reproduction, or physics-navigation claim.
deployment_contract: Prediction diagnostic enabled at default 384 train/96 inducing budgets; measured-only navigation surface, no unknown completion and no GP observed refinement. This isolates the opt-in prediction diagnostic from the deployed risk input. Offline occupancy prior differs from the ROS upstream pose-risk prior.

gates.interpretation: Engineering screening targets declared before this batch, not literature standards. Empty accepted domains are not a pass. Latency gates apply only to named components. Unsafe reference denominators are always reported.

planning.role: Bounded integration diagnosis on measured-only fresh maps, not a safety-qualified deployment. Full safe connector, safe partial path, unsafe path, and refusal are separate outcomes.

statistics: One geometry/source group is the statistical unit. Repeated masks, yaw states, noise seeds on flat geometry, and planner timing repeats do not create independent environments. Bootstrap source groups; disclose only 3 road sequence groups.
reference: Generated dense surface and analytic geometry give controlled 2.5D references; public road/indoor give sparse semantic/mesh proxies only where finite. Artificially withheld cells were observed before masking. Naturally missing cells are separate and not scored without finite reference.
